user.title: Set up scanner gateways
user.description: Leave host/MAC pairs empty for mock only. All active Home Assistant users and internal automations may use physical operations. PSK configures this integration only, not ESP firmware. Use HTTPS or a trusted management network.

data.clear_psk: Explicitly clear gateway 1 key (only for unencrypted firmware)
data.clear_psk_2: Explicitly clear gateway 2 key (only for unencrypted firmware)

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure scanner gateways
reconfigure.description: Blank keys retain existing keys for the same MAC; stored keys are never displayed. Changing this form does not enable or disable firmware encryption. All active Home Assistant users and internal automations may use physical operations.

data.noise_psk_2: Replacement second API key (blank retains existing)

reauth_confirm.title: Verify ESPHome API credentials
reauth_confirm.description: Enter replacement keys. Blank retains a stored key. This checks API identity and bridge support only; it does not issue a Modbus transaction or change firmware.

error.gateway_pair_required: Provide both host and MAC, or leave both empty.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
error.duplicate_gateway: Gateways must have distinct hosts and MACs.
error.invalid_psk: Use a base64-encoded 32-byte ESPHome API key.
error.conflicting_psk: Do not enter a replacement key and select clear for the same gateway.
error.invalid_auth: API authentication failed. Check the key and the firmware encryption setting.
error.cannot_connect: Could not verify gateway API identity and bridge support. Existing settings were not changed.

physical_permission.message: An active HA user identity or internal automation context is required.

gateway_failure.message: Gateway operation failed ({code}). Check gateway health and API configuration.

gateway_action_required.title: Scanner gateway requires attention
gateway_action_required.description: Gateway error: {code}. Check the configured MAC, API encryption key and versioned bridge firmware. For FIRMWARE_FAULT, the firmware has blocked further reads because transport state is uncertain; arrange manual device maintenance. Do not repeatedly restart scans or clear encryption to bypass an authentication error.
